trans-unit.id: Create a Google account used only for WitnessRecord, and sign in to it here. Crucially, do not add that account to your iPhone's Settings, the Gmail or Drive apps, or any browser you're signed into. trans-unit.id: Once every small chunk of a session is safely uploaded, WitnessRecord merges them into a single video per camera, uploads that to the session's Drive folder, and then deletes the small chunks — so you get one clean file per camera instead of a folder full of pieces. This never happens until the small chunks are already confirmed in Drive, so nothing is at risk while it runs. Turn this off to keep the individual chunks instead.
trans-unit.source: Once every small chunk of a session is safely uploaded, WitnessRecord merges them into a single video per camera, uploads that to the session's Drive folder, and then deletes the small chunks — so you get one clean file per camera instead of a folder full of pieces. This never happens until the small chunks are already confirmed in Drive, so nothing is at risk while it runs. Turn this off to keep the individual chunks instead.
trans-unit.target: Una vez que todos los pequeños fragmentos de una sesión se han subido de forma segura, WitnessRecord los combina en un solo video por cámara, lo sube a la carpeta de Drive de la sesión y luego elimina los fragmentos pequeños — así obtienes un archivo limpio por cámara en lugar de una carpeta llena de piezas. Esto nunca ocurre hasta que los fragmentos ya están confirmados en Drive, así que no hay ningún riesgo mientras se ejecuta. Desactiva esto para conservar en su lugar los fragmentos individuales.
